# Stormglide Technologies

> Stormglide is a software company based in Accra, Ghana. We design and build websites, web applications, mobile apps, SaaS products, and business systems for organizations in Ghana and across Africa.

## Core services

- [Software development services](https://stormglide.io/services): Custom software, SaaS, web apps, mobile apps, and product design.
- [Website development in Ghana](https://stormglide.io/services/website-development-ghana): Corporate websites, e-commerce, responsive design, local payments, and search-ready implementation.
- [Web app development in Ghana](https://stormglide.io/services/web-app-development-ghana): Business systems, workflow automation, ERP, HR, inventory, logistics, CRM, and SaaS platforms.
- [Mobile app development in Ghana](https://stormglide.io/services/mobile-app-development-ghana): iOS, Android, offline-first products, payments, and backend integrations.
- [UI and UX design](https://stormglide.io/services/design-services-ghana): Product, interface, and design-system work.
- [MVP development](https://stormglide.io/services/prototyping-ghana): Focused prototypes and first production releases.

## Products and evidence

- [Products](https://stormglide.io/products): Stormglide software for HR, logistics, health, manufacturing, and commerce.
- [Nexus HRM](https://stormglide.io/nexus-hrm): HR, payroll, leave, attendance, performance, and compliance workflows.
- [CargoScan](https://stormglide.io/cargoscan): CBM calculation, freight estimates, cargo workflows, and shipment reports.
- [SANO Health](https://stormglide.io/sano-health): Digital health and clinic workflow tools for African contexts.
- [Case studies and live systems](https://stormglide.io/work): Selected products and client software built by Stormglide.
